# Notation: every field

The fields each file accepts (anything else is an error, E001). Examples and details: the skill's
[reference](../../src/pagan/skill/reference.md). Fields shared by sprites, tilesets and models mean the same
in each.

## Palette - `palettes/<name>.pal.yaml`

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | palette name; must match the file name (`dusk.pal.yaml` -> `dusk`) |
| `description` | what the palette is for |
| `colors` | key (one Unicode letter or digit) -> `"#rrggbb"`, `"#rrggbbaa"` or `{ hex, name }` |
| `ramps` | ramp name -> keys, dark to light (one ramp per material) |
| `variants` | palette-wide recolours every asset using this palette gets |
| `base_variant` | the base colours' name on assets that get these variants |

## Palette colour (long form)

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `hex` | `#rrggbb` or `#rrggbbaa` (translucent) |
| `name` | a readable name |

## Palette variant

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ramp_swap` | ramp -> ramp of the same length |
| `key_swap` | key -> key |
| `tags` | only assets with one of these tags get the variant |

## Sprite - `sprites/<name>.sprite.yaml`

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | asset name: lowercase letters, digits, `_`, `-`; must match the file name |
| `description` | what it is and what it should look like (keep it current) |
| `palette` | palette name (default: pagan.toml `default_palette`); open mode also allows an inline palette |
| `variants` | recolours built as `<name>.<variant>`: `ramp_swap`, `key_swap`, `palette` |
| `variant_axes` | recolours that combine, one option per axis (`<a>+<b>` variants) |
| `base_variant` | the base colours' name among the variants (manifest lists the base sheet under it too) |
| `tags` | free-form labels (also select palette-wide variants) |
| `status` | `draft` or `approved` |
| `style_version` | the project style version it was made/reviewed under (W006 when older) |
| `lint` | per-asset lint: `disable`, `for` (per frame/tile/animation), `max_ramps` |
| `supersample` | authored at N x the output size; the build box-filters it down |
| `size` | width, height of one frame (`[w, h]` or `"WxH"`), up to 4096 each |
| `pivot` | anchor in pixel-edge coordinates (default bottom centre) |
| `mirror` | `none` or `horizontal` (author the left half only) |
| `outline` | `none`, `auto` (1 px), or rings `{ width, color, skip_translucent }` |
| `outline_color` | colour of `outline: auto` (default: the darkest opaque colour) |
| `shadow` | drop shadow `{ offset: [dx, dy], color }` of the outlined shape |
| `frames` | frame name -> rows of keys (`.` = transparent), or a derived frame `{ from, flip, scale, rotate, about, shift }` |
| `frames_png` | frames read from an indexed PNG: `{ file, keys, frames }` (before `frames:`) |
| `animations` | name -> `{ frames, fps, loop, durations, loop_from }` (or a list of frames); mirrored: `{ from, flip }` |
| `nine_slice` | 9-slice margins `[left, top, right, bottom]`, or per frame |
| `font` | the frames are a font's glyphs (manifest metrics + `.fnt`) |
| `points` | named attachment points `[x, y]`, or per frame |
| `sheet_columns` | frames per sheet row (default up to 8) |
| `trim` | crop frames to their content and pack them (default: `[build] trim`) |

## Sprite `frames_png:`

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `file` | the PNG, relative to the sprite file: indexed (mode P), a grid of frame-sized cells |
| `keys` | PNG palette index -> palette key or `"."` for every index used |
| `frames` | frame names, one per cell, left to right, top to bottom |

## Sprite `font:`

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `glyphs` | characters in glyph order (a string or a list of strings) |
| `cell` | glyph cell size (default: the frame size) |
| `baseline` | rows from the cell top to the baseline (default: cell height) |
| `line_height` | default: cell height |
| `advance` | `auto` (drawn width + spacing) or a fixed number (default: cell width) |
| `spacing` | auto advance: pixels after each glyph |
| `space` | auto advance of blank glyphs such as `" "` (default: half the cell) |
| `advances` | per-character advance |
| `offsets` | per-character draw offset `x` or `[x, y]` |
| `skip_blank` | blank cells aren't glyphs (the engine falls back to another font) |

## Tileset - `tiles/<name>.tiles.yaml`

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | asset name: lowercase letters, digits, `_`, `-`; must match the file name |
| `description` | what it is and what it should look like (keep it current) |
| `palette` | palette name (default: pagan.toml `default_palette`); open mode also allows an inline palette |
| `variants` | recolours built as `<name>.<variant>`: `ramp_swap`, `key_swap`, `palette` |
| `variant_axes` | recolours that combine, one option per axis (`<a>+<b>` variants) |
| `base_variant` | the base colours' name among the variants (manifest lists the base sheet under it too) |
| `tags` | free-form labels (also select palette-wide variants) |
| `status` | `draft` or `approved` |
| `style_version` | the project style version it was made/reviewed under (W006 when older) |
| `lint` | per-asset lint: `disable`, `for` (per frame/tile/animation), `max_ramps` |
| `supersample` | authored at N x the output size; the build box-filters it down |
| `tile_size` | width, height of one tile |
| `columns` | atlas width in tiles (tiles fill rows in file order) |
| `tiles` | tile name -> rows of keys, or a derived tile |
| `animations` | animated tiles: name -> `{ frames, fps, new_row, durations }` (always loop) |
| `export_textures` | tiles / tile groups as their own repeatable PNGs (+ Godot materials) |
| `tile_shape` | `square`, `isometric`, `half_offset_square` or `hexagon` (Godot's TileSet) |
| `tile_layout` | `stacked`, `stacked_offset`, `stairs_right`, `stairs_down`, `diamond_right` or `diamond_down` |
| `tile_offset_axis` | `horizontal` or `vertical` |

## 3D model - `models/<name>.model.yaml`

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `name` | asset name: lowercase letters, digits, `_`, `-`; must match the file name |
| `description` | what it is and what it should look like (keep it current) |
| `palette` | palette name (default: pagan.toml `default_palette`); open mode also allows an inline palette |
| `variants` | recolours built as `<name>.<variant>`: `ramp_swap`, `key_swap`, `palette` |
| `variant_axes` | recolours that combine, one option per axis (`<a>+<b>` variants) |
| `base_variant` | the base colours' name among the variants (manifest lists the base sheet under it too) |
| `tags` | free-form labels (also select palette-wide variants) |
| `status` | `draft` or `approved` |
| `style_version` | the project style version it was made/reviewed under (W006 when older) |
| `lint` | per-asset lint: `disable`, `for` (per frame/tile/animation), `max_ramps` |
| `supersample` | authored at N x the output size; the build box-filters it down |
| `size` | frame size in pixels |
| `pivot` | where `origin` lands in every frame |
| `origin` | model point on the pivot (default: centre of the bounds at the bottom) |
| `outline` | `auto` (default) or `none` |
| `outline_color` | outline colour (default: the darkest opaque colour) |
| `directions` | headings rendered: 1, 4, 8, 16 or 32; 0 = a mesh only |
| `heading` | first heading in degrees |
| `camera` | override of any pagan.toml `[camera]` key |
| `light` | override of any pagan.toml `[light]` key |
| `materials` | name -> `{ keys \| ramp, two_sided }`: palette ramps that shade the parts |
| `parts` | shapes applied in order: `box`, `hull`, `cylinder`, `ring`, `ellipsoid`, `line`, `sail`, `triangle`, `layers` (+ `id`, `mirror`, `carve`, `hidden`) |
| `animations` | pose animations: name -> `{ fps, loop, interpolation, poses }`; a pose moves parts (`offset`, `roll`, `pitch`, `yaw`, `about`), `show`s or `hide`s them |
| `extends` | a `template: true` model this one builds on |
| `remove` | part ids of the base to drop |
| `template` | only a base for `extends`: linted, never built |
| `rig` | meshes: how parts become nodes (parents, pivots) |
| `voxel_size` | meshes: metres per voxel for this model (overrides `[mesh] voxel_size`) |

## Timeline preview - `scenes/<name>.timeline.yaml`

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `size` | canvas size in output pixels |
| `fps` | timeline frames per second |
| `duration` | seconds |
| `layers` | sprites drawn in list order (later on top) |
| `background` | `"#rrggbb"` (default transparent) |

## Timeline layer

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `sprite` | asset name (sprites and models, not tilesets) |
| `anim` | an animation, or a frame shown still |
| `at` | where the sprite's pivot goes `[x, y]` |
| `start` | seconds (default 0) |
| `duration` | how long the layer is shown, or how long the move takes with `from`/`to` |
| `alpha` | 0-1 (default 1) |
| `fade_in` | seconds |
| `fade_out` | seconds |
| `from` | start of a straight move (instead of `at`) |
| `to` | end of the move (the layer stays there) |
| `then` | the animation after a one-shot `anim` ends |
| `variant` | a variant of the sprite |

Models: `template`, `extends`, `remove` are never inherited through `extends`, nor are what the asset is
and how it's reviewed (`name`, `description`, `tags`, `status`, `style_version`, `lint`).
